title: Sweep route: two dashes into throw
summary: End the shown heavy-kick route in crouching heavy kick, then spend the knockdown time with two forward dashes before throwing.
notation: st.HP > CDR > st.HK > st.HK > cr.HK > Dash > Dash > Throw

inputs.label: Forward throw
inputs.cue: The throw is a separate wake-up action after the sweep.

conditions: Use the shown two-heavy-kick route into sweep before the two dashes
notes: The source labels the position after the two dashes +2. That is source-reported timing, not a current-patch test.
The throw happens after the sweep knockdown; it is not part of the uninterrupted damage combo.
